name: Tafre
description: A scarred adventurer and storyteller, a trapfinder for the Akoum Expeditionary House, who shares his fire with Gideon and tells of a field of flesh.

description_citations.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Tafre shares his fire and tells Gideon strange stories, then describes waking in a field of flesh and burning yellow dust.
timeline.quote: And then I remember nothing ... until I awoke in a field of flesh.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Gideon is woken by soldiers beating and netting a surrakar that washed up in Keff.
timeline.quote: Beating it with cudgels until it collapsed, the soldiers threw a weighted net over it as it screeched in an unfamiliar tongue.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.
